lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Nadège, this is Beth. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the overnight fast went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your energy been this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good. Busy, but good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay, good.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to finish eating by 7 on 4 nights?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: It went really well, I actually did it 4 times.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My diabetes is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. My family eats late, like at 9, and I'm not going to eat alone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Finishing dinner a little earlier, like by 7, makes the 13 hours a lot easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good for you for planning ahead.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You think you can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you eat breakfast every day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, not yet. I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're already doing things to make it easier.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My sugar was better the weeks I ate earlier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is coffee with milk the first thing you have?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, yes. I told my family I'm done eating at 8.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe finish eating by 8 on 3 nights?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: 9. Maybe 10.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was work, and next week you're going to finish eating by 8 on 3 nights. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. You got it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Nadège. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

flags.reason: Pushes a 7pm dinner target without asking permission, after participant had planned 8pm; MI non-adherent.
Asks whether 5 days is realistic right after participant settled on 3 days; pushes toward higher goal.
Participant gave a reason to change (line 34, better sugar with earlier eating); coach moved to a new topic instead of exploring it.
Summary says 'the hard part was work,' which the participant never said; the earlier 'hard week' came from the coach.

score.summary: Beth reviewed the fasting goal, affirmed Nadège's effort, and helped her set a concrete next-week goal with a confidence check and follow-up plan. She pushed toward a 7pm target and 5 days, and missed exploring the sugar-related reason, though Nadège's own plan (8pm, 3 nights) still won out.
strengths: Affirmed effort after the 4/4 week (line 10) and planning ahead (line 22).
Used reflections of ambivalence and commitment (lines 15, 27, 39).
Let Nadège set the final goal and checked confidence (lines 41-44).
coaching_tips: Line 19: ask permission before suggesting a 7pm target; Nadège had planned 8pm.
Line 35: explore the sugar-improvement reason she offered in line 34 before changing topics.
Line 45: summarize only what the participant said; the 'hard part was work' detail was not hers.
Line 13: avoid pushing a higher goal after she chose 3 days; reflect her plan instead.
